_comment: The ONLY place provider knowledge lives. Skill prose must never carry a model id,
A model has one or more ROUTES, tried in order. A route is the same underlying model
at a different reseller. Failing over from minimax-h3 to seedance would silently
change the film, so a different model is a different entry here, never a fallback.
`input` is the route's REAL request contract captured from its own doc page: required
fields, defaults, types and per-role reference field names. Providers disagree in ways
that fail at submit -- kie's wan wants duration as a string, seedance as an integer;
wavespeed puts the model in the URL path and has no `input` wrapper at all.
`schemaVerified:false` means the contract is still a guess and the CLI says so before
spending. `verified:false` means no job has ever succeeded on that route.
`measuredCredits` is a FACT from a real job (see runs/.ledger.jsonl); `priceUsd` is an
Measured 2026-09-10 on kie: seedream-5-pro basic 1:1 = 7 credits; seedance-2-fast
4s/480p/16:9 = 46.8 credits, returned 864x496 @24fps with native audio. Video is ~7x
an image there, so budget in credits rather than in the USD guesses.

WaveSpeed's docs describe outputs as { video: url }; the live API returns outputs as an ARRAY of urls. extractUrls is deliberately liberal and absorbed the difference -- do not tighten it to a documented shape.

kie.label: kie.ai
kie.keySteps: Sign in at kie.ai, open API Key in the sidebar and copy the key. New accounts get a few free credits; top up under Billing.
kie.usdPerCreditSource: kie.ai pricing page: 1,000 credits = $5 at the base tier (read 2026-10-24).

jobs.note: { model, input, callBackUrl }. Errors arrive as HTTP 200 with body code 500.

wavespeed.label: WaveSpeed
wavespeed.keySteps: Sign in at wavespeed.ai, open Access Keys, press Generate and copy the key at once (it is shown only once). Add credit under Billing.

v3.note: Model is the URL path; the body IS the input object. Errors use HTTP status. Their docs warn against blindly retrying a POST -- a disconnected response may still be an accepted prediction, which is exactly the exit-5 rule.

minimax-h3.notes: Source model for kinetic-typography and editorial-collage; running those two here is a native route, not an adaptation. Cheapest capable motion in the table on kie (8 credits/s at 768P). Text renders legibly but letterforms wobble, so brand-exact copy is still `kie render`. Audio is always generated; strip it in finishing when the film is silent.

pricing.source: kie.ai/hailuo-h3, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text, re-checked): 8 and 13 credits/s. Input video is billed at the same rate; images after the fifth cost 4 credits each (not modelled here).

input.note: The docs default to 2K (13 credits/s); this table defaults to 768P (8 credits/s). Audio cannot be turned off.

i2vInput.note: No aspect_ratio: the output follows the first frame. The provider also accepts a last frame alone; this table requires a first frame, because that is what switches the CLI to this model.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 480p (the route default), list price. The playground showed 50% off ($0.02/s at 480p); WaveSpeed says the final task charge prevails, so real charges may be lower.

pricing.source: wavespeed.ai/models/wavespeed-ai/minimax-h3/text-to-video, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): billed per generated second, 480p $0.04, 540p $0.06, 768p $0.08, 1080p $0.16 (list).

routes.measuredNote: VERIFIED twice: 3s/480p/16:9 in 24s wall (15.6s inference), and the full 5.7KB kinetic-typography source prompt at 10s in 84s. Both returned 832x480 @24fps WITH native audio, hot at -10 to -12 LUFS -- run kie assemble to normalise. Far faster than the kie route (24s vs 111s for a comparable job).

routes.priceNote: Not found on 2026-10-30: kie.ai/hailuo-h3-max and docs.kie.ai/market/minimax/hailuo-h3-max-t2v return 404, the docs index has no H3 Max and the pricing page has no row. The model was probably withdrawn; expect the create to be rejected (free). 0.9 is unsupported.

seedance-2.notes: The skill's preferred general route where a preset has no native model.

input.note: i2v requires `image`. `last_image` drives the end frame -- the pair is what lets a long film be split into segments that share a frame at the seam.

pricing.source: wavespeed.ai/models/bytedance/seedance-2.0/text-to-video, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): output-only 480p $0.12/s, 720p $0.24/s, 1080p $0.60/s, 4k $1.20/s (list). With reference videos 0.075/0.15/0.375/0.75 per second (not modelled here).

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 720p (the route default), list price. The playground showed 10% off. The earlier 0.54 was 5s at 480p after that discount.

pricing.source: kie.ai/seedance-2-0, Seedance 2 tab (in the page's embedded pricing; the visible default tab is Fast), read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): 19/41/102/208 credits/s without video input. With video input 11.5/25/62/128 credits/s billed on input plus output seconds (not modelled here). kie marks these beta prices.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 720p. The earlier 1.2 could not be reproduced from the page.

seedance-2-fast.notes: Draft tier and the cheapest verified video route. WaveSpeed lists no `fast` variant, so this has no fallback.

routes.measuredNote: 4s/480p/16:9 in ~111s, returned 864x496 @24fps with native audio. 480p is a request, not a promise.

videoInput.source: kie.ai/seedance-2-0, read 2026-11-17 (direct page text): with video input 6.8 credits/s at 480P and 15 at 720P, 'With video = Price x (Input + Output)'. docs.kie.ai/market/bytedance/seedance-2-fast.md, same day: up to 3 reference videos, 15 seconds in total.

pricing.source: kie.ai/seedance-2-0, Fast tab, read 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-17 (direct page text): 11.7 credits/s at 480p and 24.8 at 720p without video input. Matches the measured 46.8 credits for 4s at 480p.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 720p (the route default).

promptProfile.refTokenSource: kie's Seedance 2.5 docs name no token (docs.kie.ai/market/bytedance/seedance-2-5.md, read 2026-11-01). ByteDance's API is reported to use [Image 1] in send order (github.com/paperfoot/seedance-cli; vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/seedance-2.0-fast). Unverified by a paid run.

seedance-2-5.notes: Newest Seedance; what Higgsfield's Cinema Studio 4.0 runs on. Billed per second on both routes and cheaper on kie. A first frame cannot be combined with reference images. Audio is on unless --param generate_audio=false. Draft mode (--param draft=true at 480p) previews cheaply; draftFinalize turns a draft into 1080p.

pricing.source: kie.ai/seedance-2-5, read 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-30: 28/63/158 credits/s without video input; reference images add nothing. With a reference video it is 17/38/95 credits/s billed on input plus output seconds (videoInput). Reference audio adds nothing (docs.kie.ai, read 2026-11-19).

videoInput.source: docs.kie.ai/market/bytedance/seedance-2-5.md, read 2026-11-19: with reference video(s), a lower per-second price x (total reference-video duration + output duration); reference images and reference audio add no billable seconds.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is only the fallback when duration or resolution is unknown: 15s at 720p (945 credits).
routes.measuredNote: 15s/720p/16:9 with 6 reference_image_urls in ~248s (job b3c42935, 2026-10-24); returned 1280x720 @24fps with native audio even though the prompt asked for silence.

requires.draft_task_id: task id of a job submitted with draft=true; valid 7 days

draftFinalize.note: Price not captured and no command uses it yet. Source: docs.kie.ai/market/bytedance/seedance-2-5-draft.md, read 2026-10-30. kie.ai/seedance-2-5 shows no price for it (read 2026-11-01); the studio re-runs at 720p/1080p instead.

refRules.note: Frame-to-video and reference-to-video are separate modes; for strict frame matching use frames, not reference images.

input.note: Draft mode requires resolution 480p. Reference images: jpeg/png/webp, 300-6000 px per side, aspect 0.4-2.5, under 30 MB, at most 30.

pricing.source: wavespeed.ai/models/bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): 480p $0.18, 720p $0.36, 1080p $0.90, 4k $1.80 per second (list; the playground showed 10% off). With reference videos 0.11/0.22/0.55/1.10 per second (not modelled here).

routes.priceNote: The earlier 0.81 was 480p for 5s at 10% off, not a per-job price. priceUsd is 5s at 720p.

kling-3-0.notes: Strongest camera-motion adherence of the set. Good for preset recipes built on a named camera move.

pricing.source: kie.ai/kling-3-0, read 2026-11-17 (direct page text): 720P Standard 15.1 credits/s without audio, 22.7 with; 1080P Pro 20.2 without, 30.2 with; 4K 75.5 credits/s either way. On 2026-10-30 the page said 14/20, 18/27 and 67. Rates here assume audio on, so a silent job is overcounted by a third; 4K is a separate mode, not modelled.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 10s Pro with audio, the most a job in this route's 5/10s range costs short of 4K. The docs name the model kling-3.0/video; this route's id is unverified and may be rejected (free).

wan-2-6.notes: Cheap tier. No aspect-ratio control at all -- reframe afterwards with kie variants. WaveSpeed carries Wan 3.0, a DIFFERENT model, so that is a separate entry rather than a fallback.

input.note: No aspect_ratio parameter exists on this model.

pricing.source: kie.ai/wan-2-6, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): 70/140/210 credits for 5/10/15s at 720p and 105/210/315 at 1080p, i.e. 14 and 21 credits/s.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 720p (the route default).

wan-3-0.notes: A different model from wan-2-6, not a newer route to it. WaveSpeed only.

pricing.source: wavespeed.ai/models/alibaba/wan-3.0/text-to-video, read 2026-10-30 (direct page text): per second 480p $0.05, 720p $0.10, 1080p $0.20 (list; the playground showed 5% off), durations 2-30s.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 5s at 720p, list price. The earlier 0.475 was the 5%-off playground figure.

veo-3-1.notes: Native dialogue and SFX audio. Its own API family on kie, plus an extend route -- the escape hatch when one job cannot reach the length a preset wants.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/veo-3-1, read 2026-10-30: per video, Lite 30/35/150 credits, Fast 60/65/180, Quality 250/255/370 at 720p/1080p/4K. priceUsd is Quality at 1080p, the dearest non-4K tier, because which tier this route's model id selects is not known. The docs list veo3, veo3_fast and veo3_lite; this route sends veo3_1, which may be rejected (free).

seedream-5-pro.notes: Cheap style frames, and the first route verified end to end here.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/seedream-5-0-pro, read 2026-10-30: 7 credits ($0.035) at 1K, 14 ($0.07) at 2K; input images after the first 0.5 credits each. The measured basic 1:1 job was 7 credits; priceUsd assumes 2K because whether quality "high" means 2K is unconfirmed.
wavespeed.ai/models/bytedance/seedream-v5.0-pro, read 2026-10-30: 1k and 1.5k $0.045, 2k $0.09 (list; the playground showed 10% off). priceUsd assumes 2k.

gpt-image-2.notes: The source workflow's preferred reference-image model. WaveSpeed carries GPT Image 2.5, a different version, so it is not a fallback here.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/gpt-image-2, read 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-17: 6/10/16 credits ($0.03/$0.05/$0.08) at 1K/2K/4K. No contract is captured for this route, so a job that names no resolution is priced at 4K.

gpt-image-2-5.notes: Top of the Artificial Analysis image-editing board (Oct 2026). Sunburst variant. Edits from a reference with --ref URL:identity, and --background transparent returns a cut-out PNG.

routes.priceNote: 6 credits at 1K, 10 at 2K, 16 at 4K, image-to-image included (kie.ai/gpt-image-2-5, read 2026-10-24).
routes.measuredNote: image-to-image, 2K, background transparent, 1-2 input_urls: 10 credits, 34-65s, 2048x2048 RGBA PNG (run zethus-hero-ink, 2026-10-24).

nano-banana-2.notes: Strong at text inside the image, which matters for typography presets. Takes up to 10 reference images in one field.

routes.schemaSource: docs.kie.ai/market/google/nanobanana2, read 2026-10-31. The model id is nano-banana-2; the earlier google/nanobanana2 was a guess.
routes.priceNote: kie.ai/nano-banana-2, read 2026-10-30: 8/12/18 credits ($0.04/$0.06/$0.09) at 1K/2K/4K. priceUsd assumes 2K.

elevenlabs-v3.notes: Character voices: one speaker reading a script with emotion tags such as [whispers] and [laughs]. Voices are kie's ElevenLabs presets (cli/voices.json); each previews free.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/pricing, read 2026-11-19: Elevenlabs V3 14 credits ($0.07) per 1,000 characters. priceUsd (1,000 characters) is only the fallback when the script is not known.

input.note: dialogue is a list of { text, voice }; all text together at most 5,000 characters. language_code is optional (blank detects the language).

elevenlabs-tts.notes: Narration. Presets default to no narration -- see SKILL.md production defaults.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/elevenlabs-tts, read 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-17: 12 credits ($0.06) per 1,000 characters. priceUsd (2,000 characters) is only the fallback when the script is not known.

suno-music.notes: Instrumental bed. The skill's default campaign audio is music plus effects, no narration.

routes.priceNote: kie.ai/suno-api, read 2026-10-30: 12 credits ($0.06) per Generate Music request (Extend is also 12). The docs name the model ai-music-api/generate with input.model V6; this route's id is unverified and may be rejected (free).

kling-2-6-motion-control.label: Kling 2.6 Motion Control
kling-2-6-motion-control.notes: Motion transfer, Standard: one character picture performs the motion of a 3-30s reference video. Picture and video must show head, shoulders and torso. Orientation 'image' caps the video at 10s. The output may keep the reference video's audio.

pricing.source: kie.ai/kling-2.6-motion-control, read 2026-11-18: 12.6 credits/s ($0.063) at 720P, 20.2 credits/s ($0.101) at 1080P. Contract from docs.kie.ai/market/kling/motion-control the same day.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is a 30s clip at 1080p, the most one job can cost. The bill follows the reference video's length.

kling-3-0-motion-control.label: Kling 3.0 Motion Control
kling-3-0-motion-control.notes: Motion transfer, Pro: better identity and expression hold than 2.6. Same inputs; each side of both files over 340px, aspect 2:5 to 5:2.

pricing.source: kie.ai/kling-3-motion-control, read 2026-11-18: 22.7 credits/s ($0.1135) at 720P, 30.2 credits/s ($0.151) at 1080P. Contract from docs.kie.ai/market/kling/motion-control-v3 the same day.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is a 30s clip at 1080p, the most one job can cost. The bill follows the reference video's length.

wan-2-2-animate-replace.label: Wan 2.2 Animate Replace
wan-2-2-animate-replace.notes: Character swap: the person in the video is replaced by the character in the picture, keeping the scene, camera and motion. Files are capped at 10MB each; no prompt.

routes.measuredNote: 6.6s skydive clip + one character picture at 480p on 2026-11-18: succeeded in ~2 min, 36 credits ($0.18; estimate $0.201 at 6.7s), returned 464x832 at the clip's 6.56s. The person was replaced and the plane, sky and motion kept.

pricing.source: kie.ai/wan-animate, read 2026-11-18: 6 credits/s at 480p ($0.03), 9.5 at 580p ($0.0475), 12.5 at 720p ($0.0625). Contract from docs.kie.ai/market/wan/2-2-animate-replace the same day; it states no length limit, only 10MB per file.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is a 30s clip at 720p. The bill follows the video's length.

minimax-h3-swap.label: MiniMax H3
minimax-h3-swap.notes: Character swap by instruction: the video and the picture go to H3's reference-to-video with a written edit (the model Openjutsu runs locally, without its masks). It also redraws the sound. Billed on the output's seconds plus the reference video's seconds; the video may be at most 15s.

routes.measuredNote: A 12.9s portrait dance clip (720x1280) + a Library character's three-panel sheet, person swap at 768P with aspect_ratio adaptive, on 2026-11-18: succeeded in ~13.5 min, charged $1.00 (estimate $1.04 for 13s + 13s). One person with the sheet's face and uniform, no grey oval, the dance and the room kept. But adaptive returned 1344x768 (16:9) for a 9:16 clip, widening the room; the studio now sends the clip's nearest ratio.

pricing.source: kie.ai/minimax-h3, read 2026-11-18: 8 credits/s at 768P ($0.04), 13 at 2K ($0.065), for the output and for input video at the same rate; pictures after the fifth 4 credits ($0.02) each. Contract from docs.kie.ai/market/minimax-h3/reference-to-video the same day: prompt 1-7000 characters, duration 4-15 (whole seconds), up to 9 pictures (256-5760px a side, aspect 0.4-2.5, 30MB) and 3 videos (2-15s each, 15s in all, 50MB, 23.976-60fps). Audio is always generated.

routes.priceNote: priceUsd is 15s of output from a 15s clip at 2K, the most one job can cost.
